parsed.post: Discarding the last run (1.111). The combination of DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.15 + WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 was too unstable. Reverting to my best (1.059885). I'll try a more conservative step: reducing the learning rate slightly while keeping the depth and warmup to find a more stable convergence path.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.1 to 0.08 while keeping WARMUP_RATIO at 0.05 to improve stability for DEPTH=6.
